description.zh: ACR企业版实例信息列表。更多信息，请参见[免密拉取ACR镜像](~~194250~~)。
description.en: The list of ACR Enterprise Edition instance information. For more information, see [Pull images from ACR without a password](~~194250~~).

description.zh: ECI实例等资源归属账号下的RAM角色的ARN。
description.en: The ARN of the RAM role under the account that owns the ECI instance and other resources.

description.zh: ACR实例归属账号下的RAM角色的ARN。
description.en: The ARN of the RAM role under the account that owns the ACR instance.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例的域名。默认为相应实例的所有域名。支持指定个别域名，多个以半角逗号分隔。
description.en: The domains of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance. By default, all domains of the instance are used. You can specify individual domains, separated by commas.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例的名称。
description.en: The name of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

description.zh: ACR企业版实例所属地域。
description.en: The region of the ACR Enterprise Edition instance.

description.zh: ECI实例的有效期限，超出该时间后，实例会被强制退出。单位为秒。
description.en: The validity period of the ECI instance. The instance is forcibly terminated after this period expires. Unit: seconds.

description.zh: 是否自动创建一个EIP，并绑定到ECI实例上。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically create an EIP and bind it to the ECI instance.

description.zh: 是否自动匹配镜像缓存。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically match image caches. Default value: false.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参阅[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can only contain ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 指定算力类别。更多信息，请参见[指定算力类别创建实例](~~2638061~~)。
description.en: The compute categories. For more information, see [Create instances by specifying compute categories](~~2638061~~).

description.zh: 容器信息。
description.en: The container information.

description.zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多10个。
description.en: The arguments for the container startup command. Maximum: 10.

description.zh: 容器启动命令。最多20个。每个命令最多包含256个字符。
description.en: The container startup commands. Maximum: 20. Each command can contain up to 256 characters.

description.zh: 容器的vCPU大小。单位：核。
description.en: The vCPU size of the container. Unit: cores.

description.zh: 容器的环境变量值。
description.en: The environment variables of the container.

description.zh:
查询ECI实例详情时，是否隐藏环境变量信息。取值范围：

- false（默认值）：查询ECI实例详情时，不隐藏环境变量信息。
- true：查询ECI实例详情时，不返回环境变量信息。在环境变量带有敏感信息时，配置为true可以提高安全性。
description.en:
Specifies whether to hide environment variable information when querying ECI instance details. Valid values:

- false (default): environment variable information is returned when querying ECI instance details.
- true: environment variable information is not returned when querying ECI instance details. Setting this to true improves security when environment variables contain sensitive information.

description.zh: 指定容器使用的GPU个数。
description.en: The number of GPUs assigned to the container.

description.zh: 容器镜像。
description.en: The container image.

description.zh:
镜像拉取策略。取值范围：

- Always：总是拉取。每次都拉取镜像。
- IfNotPresent：按需拉取。优先使用本地镜像，本地没有镜像时则拉取镜像。
- Never：从不拉取。使用本地镜像，不拉取镜像。
description.en:
The image pull policy. Valid values:

- Always: always pull. Pulls the image every time.
- IfNotPresent: pull on demand. Uses the local image first. Pulls the image if no local image is available.
- Never: never pull. Uses the local image only.

description.zh: 使用命令行方式设置postStart回调函数时，在容器内执行的命令。
description.en: The commands executed in the container when using the command method to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，接收HTTP Get请求的主机地址。
description.en: The host address that receives the HTTP Get request when using the HTTP request method to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 生成的HTTP请求头参数。
description.en: The HTTP request header parameters.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。
description.en: The HTTP Get request path when using the HTTP request method to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检查的端口号。
description.en: The HTTP Get request port number when using the HTTP request method to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式设置postStart回调函数时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：

- HTTP
- HTTPS
description.en:
The protocol type for the HTTP Get request when using the HTTP request method to set the postStart callback function. Valid values:

- HTTP
- HTTPS

description.zh: 使用TCP Socket方式设置postStart回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的主机地址。
description.en: The host address for TCP Socket detection when using the TCP Socket method to set the postStart callback function.

description.zh: 使用TCPSocket方式设置postStart回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的端口。
description.en: The TCP Socket port for the postStart callback function when using the TCPSocket method.

description.zh: 使用命令行方式设置preStop回调函数时，在容器内执行的命令。
description.en: The commands executed in the container when using the command method to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，接收HTTP Get请求的主机地址。
description.en: The host address that receives the HTTP Get request when using the HTTP request method to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 生成的HTTP请求头参数。
description.en: The HTTP request header parameters.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。
description.en: The HTTP Get request path when using the HTTP request method to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，HTTP Get请求检测的端口号。
description.en: The HTTP Get request port number when using the HTTP request method to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式设置preStop回调函数时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：

- HTTP
- HTTPS
description.en:
The protocol type for the HTTP Get request when using the HTTP request method to set the preStop callback function. Valid values:

- HTTP
- HTTPS

description.zh: 使用TCP Socket方式设置preStop回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的主机地址。
description.en: The host address for TCP Socket detection when using the TCP Socket method to set the preStop callback function.

description.zh: 使用TCPSocket方式设置preStop回调函数时，TCP Socket检测的端口。
description.en: The TCP Socket port for the preStop callback function when using the TCPSocket method.

description.zh:
使用命令行方式进行健康检查时，在容器内执行的命令。

> 设置LivenessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The commands executed in the container for command-based health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh: 从上次检查成功后认定检查失败的检查次数阈值（必须是连续失败），默认为3。
description.en: The minimum number of consecutive failures required to consider the check failed after a success. Default value: 3.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。

> 设置LivenessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The path for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求检测的端口号。

> 设置LivenessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The port number for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：

- HTTP
- HTTPS

> 设置LivenessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The protocol type for HTTP request health checks. Valid values:
- HTTP
- HTTPS

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh: 检查开始执行的时间，以容器启动完成为起点计算。
description.en: The time to start the check, calculated from when the container finishes starting.

description.zh: 检查执行的周期，默认为10秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The interval at which the check is performed. Default value: 10 seconds. Minimum value: 1 second.

description.zh: 从上次检查失败后重新认定检查成功的检查次数阈值（必须是连续成功），默认为1。当前必须为1。
description.en: The minimum number of consecutive successes required to consider the check successful after a failure. Default value: 1. Must be 1.

description.zh:
使用TCP Socket方式进行健康检查时，TCP Socket检测的端口。

> 设置LivenessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The port for TCP Socket health checks.

> When setting LivenessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh: 检查超时的时间，默认为1秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The timeout period for the check. Default value: 1 second. Minimum value: 1 second.

description.zh: 容器的内存大小。单位：GiB。
description.en: The memory size of the container. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 容器名称。
description.en: The container name.

description.zh: 端口号。
description.en: The port numbers.

description.zh:
使用命令行方式进行健康检查时，在容器内执行的命令。

> 设置ReadinessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The commands executed in the container for command-based health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh: 从上次检查成功后认定检查失败的检查次数阈值（必须是连续失败），默认为3。
description.en: The minimum number of consecutive failures required to consider the check failed after a success. Default value: 3.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求检测的路径。

> 设置ReadinessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The path for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求检测的端口号。

> 设置ReadinessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The port number for HTTP Get request health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh:
使用HTTP请求方式进行健康检查时，HTTP Get请求对应的协议类型，取值范围：
- HTTP
- HTTPS

> 设置ReadinessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The protocol type for HTTP request health checks. Valid values:
- HTTP
- HTTPS

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh: 检查开始执行的时间，以容器启动完成为起点计算。
description.en: The time to start the check, calculated from when the container finishes starting.

description.zh: 检查执行的周期，默认为10秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The interval at which the check is performed. Default value: 10 seconds. Minimum value: 1 second.

description.zh: 从上次检查失败后重新认定检查成功的检查次数阈值（必须是连续成功），默认为1。当前必须为1。
description.en: The minimum number of consecutive successes required to consider the check successful after a failure. Default value: 1. Must be 1.

description.zh:
使用TCP Socket方式进行健康检查时，TCP Socket检测的端口。

> 设置ReadinessProbe相关参数时，HttpGet、Exec和TcpSocket这三种检查方式，只能选择其中一种。
description.en:
The port for TCP Socket health checks.

> When setting ReadinessProbe parameters, only one of the three check methods (HttpGet, Exec, and TcpSocket) can be selected.

description.zh: 检查超时的时间，默认为1秒，最小为1秒。
description.en: The timeout period for the check. Default value: 1 second. Minimum value: 1 second.

description.zh:
为容器内的进程授予某些特定的权限。目前仅支持配置为NET\_ADMIN和NET\_RAW。

> NET_RAW默认不支持，需提交工单申请。
description.en:
The permissions granted to processes in the container. Currently, only NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW are supported.

> NET_RAW is not supported by default and requires a ticket submission.

description.zh: 容器运行的根文件系统是否为只读，目前仅支持配置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether the root file system of the container is read-only. Currently, only true is supported.

description.zh: 设置运行容器的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID used to run the container.

description.zh:
容器是否启用特权，即是否以特权模式运行容器。取值范围：
- true：启用特权
- false（默认值）：不启用特权

> 特权容器功能正在内测中。如需体验，请提交工单申请。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable privilege mode for the container. Valid values:
- true: enable privilege mode.
- false (default): disable privilege mode.

> The privileged container feature is in beta. To use it, submit a ticket.

description.zh: 设置运行容器的用户组。
description.en: The user group ID used to run the container.

description.zh:
是否以非root模式运行容器。取值范围：
- true：非root模式
- false（默认值）：root模式
description.en:
Specifies whether to run the container in non-root mode. Valid values:
- true: non-root mode.
- false (default): root mode.

description.zh: 此容器是否应在容器运行时为标准输入分配缓冲区。如果未设置，则容器中标准输入的读取值将导致EOF。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether this container should allocate a buffer for standard input in the container runtime. If not set, reads from standard input in the container will result in EOF. Default value: false.

description.zh:
当标准输入为true时，标准输入流将在多个附加会话中是否保持开启状态。    
如果StdinOnce设为true，标准输入在容器开启时被打开，在首个客户端附加到标准输入之前都为空，然后会一直保持开启状态，接收数据，直到客户端连接断开，此时标准输入被关闭，在容器重启前一直保持关闭状态。
description.en:
Specifies whether the standard input stream remains open across multiple attach sessions when standard input is set to true.
If StdinOnce is set to true, standard input is opened when the container starts, remains empty until the first client attaches to standard input, then stays open and accepts data until the client disconnects. Standard input is then closed and remains closed until the container restarts.

description.zh: 容器的报错地址。
description.en: The path for the container error message.

description.zh: 消息通知策略，默认为空，目前仅支持轻量消息队列的消息通知。
description.en: The message notification policy. Default value: empty. Currently, only lightweight message queue notification is supported.

description.zh:
是否开启交互。默认为false。

当Command为/bin/bash命令时，需要设置为true。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable interaction. Default value: false.

When Command is /bin/bash, this must be set to true.

description.zh: 数据卷信息。
description.en: The volume mount information.

description.zh: 容器工作目录。
description.en: The working directory of the container.

description.zh:
ECI实例名称，即容器组名称。格式要求如下：

- 长度为2~128个字符。
- 支持英文小写字母、数字或者短划线（-），不能以短划线开头或者结尾。
description.en:
The name of the ECI instance (container group). Format requirements:

- The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length.
- The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It cannot start or end with a hyphen.

description.zh: 当ECI规格比申请规格大时，可以开启该配置，确保容器内看到的资源跟申请的资源保持一致。
description.en: When the ECI specification is larger than the requested specification, you can enable this setting to ensure that the resources visible inside the container are consistent with the requested resources.

description.zh:
自定义设置coredump生成的core文件的保存目录。更多信息，请参见[设置core文件保存到数据卷](~~167801~~)。

> 配置的路径不能以`|`开头，即不能通过Core dump来配置可执行程序。
description.en:
Custom directory for saving core dump files generated by coredump. For more information, see [Save core files to a data volume](~~167801~~).

> The configured path cannot start with `|`, which means you cannot configure executable programs through core dump.

description.zh: 实例级别vCPU大小。单位：核。
description.en: The instance-level vCPU size. Unit: cores.

description.zh:
指定ECI实例的CPU架构。取值范围：

- AMD64（默认值）
- ARM64
description.en:
The CPU architecture of the ECI instance. Valid values:

- AMD64 (default)
- ARM64

description.zh: CPU物理核心数。仅部分规格支持自定义设置。
description.en: The number of physical CPU cores. Only some instance types support custom settings.

description.zh: 该参数暂不支持设置。
description.en: This parameter is not supported.

description.zh: 每核线程数。仅部分规格支持自定义设置。配置为1时表示关闭超线程。
description.en: The number of threads per core. Only some instance types support custom settings. Setting this to 1 disables hyper-threading.

description.zh: 数据缓存Bucket。
description.en: The data cache bucket.

description.zh: 数据缓存使用ESSD AutoPL云盘时，是否开启Burst（性能突发）。更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘](~~368372~~)。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable burst performance when the data cache uses ESSD AutoPL cloud disks. For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks](~~368372~~).

description.zh:
数据缓存使用的云盘的性能等级。    
优先使用ESSD云盘，性能等级默认为PL1。
description.en:
The performance level of the cloud disk used by the data cache.
ESSDs are used preferentially, and the default performance level is PL1.

description.zh:
数据缓存使用ESSD AutoPL云盘时，ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。    
取值范围：0~min{50000, 1000 * 容量-基准性能}。基准性能=min{1800+50 * 容量, 50000}。    
更多信息，请参见[ESSD AutoPL云盘](~~368372~~)。
description.en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS when the data cache uses ESSD AutoPL cloud disks.
Valid values: 0 to min{50000, 1000 * capacity - baseline performance}. Baseline performance = min{1800 + 50 * capacity, 50000}.
For more information, see [ESSD AutoPL cloud disks](~~368372~~).

description.zh: DNS服务器的IP地址列表。
description.en: The list of IP addresses of DNS servers.

description.zh: 对象的选项列表。
description.en: The list of options.

description.zh: 对象的Name。
description.en: The name of the option.

description.zh: 对象的Value。
description.en: The value of the option.

description.zh: DNS搜索域列表。
description.en: The list of DNS search domains.

description.zh:
DNS策略。取值范围：

- None：使用DnsConfig字段设置的DNS。
- Default：继承运行环境的DNS设置。
description.en:
The DNS policy. Valid values:

- None: uses the DNS configured by the DnsConfig field.
- Default: inherits the DNS settings of the runtime environment.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

- true：发送检查请求，不会创建ECI实例。检查项包括是否填写了必填参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码DryRun.Success。
- false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建ECI实例。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- true: performs a dry run without creating an ECI instance. The system checks required parameters, request format, service limits, and inventory. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, the error code DryRun.Success is returned.
- false (default): sends a normal request. After the check passes, the ECI instance is created.

description.zh: 出方向带宽限制。单位：Bps。
description.en: The outbound bandwidth limit. Unit: Bps.

description.zh:
EIP的带宽，默认为5 Mbps。    
当AutoCreateEip取值为true时，可以设置该参数。
description.en:
The bandwidth of the EIP. Default value: 5 Mbps.
This parameter can be set when AutoCreateEip is set to true.

description.zh: 绑定已有的共享带宽包。
description.en: The ID of an existing shared bandwidth package to associate.

description.zh:
设置EIP的线路类型。取值范围：

- BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路
- BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）精品线路
description.en:
The line type of the EIP. Valid values:

- BGP (default): BGP (multi-ISP) line.
- BGP_PRO: BGP (multi-ISP) premium line.

description.zh: 弹性公网IP ID。
description.en: The ID of the elastic IP address (EIP).

description.zh:
增加的临时存储空间大小。单位：GiB。    
更多信息，请参见[自定义临时存储空间大小](~~204066~~)。
description.en:
The size of the additional temporary storage space. Unit: GiB.
For more information, see [Customize the size of temporary storage](~~204066~~).

description.zh: 配置为true表示实例启用固定IP地址。具体请参见[配置ECI实例使用固定IP地址](~~2381086~~)。
description.en: Set to true to enable fixed IP addresses for the instance. For details, see [Configure ECI instances to use fixed IP addresses](~~2381086~~).

description.zh: 固定IP地址空闲后的保留时长，即启用固定IP地址的实例释放后，其固定IP地址的保留时长，单位为小时。默认值为48。
description.en: The retention period of the fixed IP address after it becomes idle, i.e., the retention period after the instance with the fixed IP address is released. Unit: hours. Default value: 48.

description.zh:
指定GPU驱动版本。

> 仅部分规格支持切换GPU驱动版本。更多信息，请参见[指定GPU规格创建实例](~~2579486~~)。
description.en:
The GPU driver version.

> Only some instance types support switching GPU driver versions. For more information, see [Create instances by specifying GPU specifications](~~2579486~~).

description.zh: 添加一个ECI的别名。
description.en: The host aliases for the ECI instance.

description.zh: 添加主机名。
description.en: The host names to add.

description.zh: 添加IP。
description.en: The IP address to add.

description.zh: 主机名称。
description.en: The host name.

description.zh: 通过安全上下文修改非安全sysctl参数。更多信息，请参见[配置Security Context](~~462313~~)。
description.en: Modifies unsafe sysctl parameters through the security context. For more information, see [Configure Security Context](~~462313~~).

description.zh:
通过安全上下文修改sysctl参数时，非安全sysctl参数的名称。取值范围：

- kernel.shm*（kernel.shm_rmid_forced除外）
- kernel.msg*
- kernel.sem
- fs.mqueue.*
- net.*（net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies、net.ipv4.ping_group_range、net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start除外）
description.en:
The name of the unsafe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context. Valid values:

- kernel.shm* (except kernel.shm_rmid_forced)
- kernel.msg*
- kernel.sem
- fs.mqueue.*
- net.* (except net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies, net.ipv4.ping_group_range, and net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start)

description.zh: 通过安全上下文修改sysctl参数时，非安全sysctl参数的取值。
description.en: The value of the unsafe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context.

description.zh:
镜像加速模式。取值范围：

- nydus：使用Nydus加速，需镜像本身支持。
- dadi：使用DADI加速，需镜像本身支持。
- p2p：使用P2P加速，需镜像本身支持。
- imc：使用镜像缓存加速。
description.en:
The image acceleration mode. Valid values:

- nydus: uses Nydus acceleration. The image must support it.
- dadi: uses DADI acceleration. The image must support it.
- p2p: uses P2P acceleration. The image must support it.
- imc: uses image cache acceleration.

description.zh: 镜像仓库信息。
description.en: The image repository credentials.

description.zh: 镜像仓库密码。
description.en: The password of the image repository.

description.zh: 镜像仓库注册地址。
description.en: The address of the image repository registry.

description.zh: 镜像仓库用户名。
description.en: The username of the image repository.

description.zh: 镜像缓存ID。更多信息，请参见[使用镜像缓存加速创建实例](~~141281~~)。
description.en: The image cache ID. For more information, see [Use image caches to accelerate instance creation](~~141281~~).

description.zh: 入方向带宽限制。单位：Bps。
description.en: The inbound bandwidth limit. Unit: Bps.

description.zh: Init容器列表。
description.en: The list of init containers.

description.zh: 容器启动参数。
description.en: The container startup arguments.

description.zh: 容器启动指令。
description.en: The container startup commands.

description.zh: 容器的vCPU大小。单位：核。
description.en: The vCPU size of the container. Unit: cores.

description.zh: 容器的环境变量信息列表。
description.en: The list of container environment variables.

description.zh: 指定容器使用的GPU个数。
description.en: The number of GPUs assigned to the container.

description.zh: 容器使用的镜像。
description.en: The image used by the container.

description.zh:
镜像拉取策略。取值范围：
- Always：总是拉取。每次都拉取镜像。
- IfNotPresent：按需拉取。优先使用本地镜像，本地没有镜像时则拉取镜像。
- Never：从不拉取。使用本地镜像，不拉取镜像。
description.en:
The image pull policy. Valid values:
- Always: always pull. Pulls the image every time.
- IfNotPresent: pull on demand. Uses the local image first. Pulls the image if no local image is available.
- Never: never pull. Uses the local image only.

description.zh: 容器的内存大小。单位：GiB。
description.en: The memory size of the container. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: 容器名称。
description.en: The container name.

description.zh: init容器端口号。
description.en: The init container port numbers.

description.zh:
为容器内的进程授予某些特定的权限。目前仅支持配置为NET\_ADMIN和NET\_RAW。

> NET_RAW默认不支持，需提交工单申请。
description.en:
The permissions granted to processes in the container. Currently, only NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW are supported.

> NET_RAW is not supported by default and requires a ticket submission.

description.zh: 容器运行的根文件系统是否为只读。目前仅支持配置为true。
description.en: Specifies whether the root file system of the container is read-only. Currently, only true is supported.

description.zh: 设置运行容器的用户ID。
description.en: The user ID used to run the container.

description.zh: 容器退出的消息来源。当容器退出时，从指定的终止消息文件中检索终止消息。
description.en: The source of the container exit message. When the container exits, the termination message is retrieved from the specified termination message file.

description.zh: 挂载信息，默认为空。
description.en: The mount information. Default value: empty.

description.zh: 挂载数据卷信息列表。
description.en: The list of volume mount information.

description.zh: 工作目录。
description.en: The working directory.

description.zh: 自建镜像仓库地址。使用自签发证书的自建镜像仓库中的镜像创建ECI实例时，需配置该参数来跳过证书认证，避免因证书认证失败而导致镜像拉取失败。
description.en: The address of a self-managed image repository. When creating ECI instances using images from a self-managed image repository that uses self-signed certificates, configure this parameter to skip certificate verification, avoiding image pull failures caused by certificate verification failure.

description.zh: 指定的ECS实例规格，支持多规格。更多信息，请参见[指定ECS规格创建实例](~~114664~~)。
description.en: The specified ECS instance type. Multiple instance types are supported. For more information, see [Create an instance by specifying an ECS instance type](~~114664~~).

description.zh: IPv6地址数。固定为1，即一个ECI实例支持绑定一个IPv6地址。
description.en: The number of IPv6 addresses. The value is fixed at 1, meaning an ECI instance supports binding one IPv6 address.

description.zh:
当Ipv6GatewayBandwidthEnable配置为true时，配置IPv6地址的公网带宽峰值。取值如下：

- 当IPv6网关的公网带宽计费方式为按固定带宽计费时，IPv6地址的公网带宽范围为1~2000 Mbps。
- 当IPv6网关的公网带宽计费方式为按使用流量计费时，IPv6地址的公网带宽范围受网关规格约束。
    - 网关为免费版，IPv6地址的公网带宽范围为1~200 Mbps。
    - 网关为企业版，IPv6地址的公网带宽范围为1~500 Mbps。
     - 网关为企业增强版，IPv6地址的公网带宽范围为1~1000 Mbps。

默认值为网关对应带宽范围的最大值。
description.en:
When Ipv6GatewayBandwidthEnable is set to true, specifies the peak public bandwidth for the IPv6 address. Valid values:

- When the IPv6 gateway uses pay-by-fixed-bandwidth billing, the IPv6 public bandwidth range is 1 to 2000 Mbps.
- When the IPv6 gateway uses pay-by-traffic billing, the IPv6 public bandwidth range depends on the gateway specification:
    - Free edition: 1 to 200 Mbps.
    - Enterprise edition: 1 to 500 Mbps.
    - Enhanced enterprise edition: 1 to 1000 Mbps.

Default value: the maximum value within the corresponding bandwidth range of the gateway.

description.zh: 是否开通ECI的IPv6公网通信能力。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable IPv6 public network communication for the ECI instance.

description.zh: 实例级别内存大小。单位：GiB。
description.en: The instance-level memory size. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: NTP服务器。
description.en: The NTP servers.

description.zh:
指定ECI实例的操作系统。取值范围：

- Linux（默认值）
- Windows

> Windows实例正在邀测中，如需使用，请提交工单申请。
description.en:
The operating system of the ECI instance. Valid values:

- Linux (default)
- Windows

> Windows instances are in beta. To use them, submit a ticket.

description.zh: 自建镜像仓库地址。使用HTTP协议的自建镜像仓库中的镜像创建ECI实例时，需配置该参数，使得ECI使用HTTP协议拉取镜像，避免因协议不同而导致镜像拉取失败。
description.en: The address of a self-managed image repository. When creating ECI instances using images from a self-managed image repository that uses the HTTP protocol, configure this parameter so that ECI uses the HTTP protocol to pull images, avoiding image pull failures caused by protocol mismatch.

description.zh: 指定ECI实例的私网IP地址。目前仅支持指定IPv4地址，请确保该IP地址没有被占用。
description.en: The private IP address of the ECI instance. Currently, only IPv4 addresses are supported. Make sure that the IP address is not already in use.

description.zh: 实例RAM角色名称。ECI与ECS共用实例RAM角色，更多信息，请参见[通过API使用实例RAM角色](~~61178~~)。
description.en: The name of the instance RAM role. ECI and ECS share instance RAM roles. For more information, see [Use an instance RAM role by calling API operations](~~61178~~).

description.zh: 地域ID。
description.en: The region ID.

description.zh: 资源组ID。
description.en: The resource group ID.

description.zh:
实例重启策略。取值范围：

- Always：总是重启
- Never：从不重启
- OnFailure：失败时重启

默认值：Always。
description.en:
The restart policy of the instance. Valid values:

- Always: always restart.
- Never: never restart.
- OnFailure: restart upon failure.

Default value: Always.

description.zh:
配置了多可用区（通过VSwitchId参数指定多个交换机）时，ECI实例的调度策略。取值范围：

- VSwitchOrdered：按顺序调度
- VSwitchRandom：阿里云最优策略调度

更多信息，请参见[多可用区创建实例](~~157290~~)。
description.en:
The scheduling strategy for the ECI instance when multiple zones are configured (by specifying multiple vSwitches via the VSwitchId parameter). Valid values:

- VSwitchOrdered: scheduled in order.
- VSwitchRandom: optimally scheduled by Alibaba Cloud.

For more information, see [Create instances across multiple zones](~~157290~~).

description.zh: 通过安全上下文修改安全sysctl参数。更多信息，请参见[配置Security Context](~~462313~~)。
description.en: Modifies safe sysctl parameters through the security context. For more information, see [Configure Security Context](~~462313~~).

description.zh:
通过安全上下文修改sysctl参数时，安全sysctl参数的名称。取值范围：

- net.ipv4.ping_group_range
- net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start
description.en:
The name of the safe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context. Valid values:

- net.ipv4.ping_group_range
- net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start

description.zh: 通过安全上下文修改sysctl参数时，安全sysctl参数的取值。
description.en: The value of the safe sysctl parameter when modifying sysctl parameters through the security context.

description.zh:
实例所属的安全组ID。同一个安全组内的实例之间可以互相访问。

如果没有指定安全组，系统将自动使用您选择的地域下的默认安全组，您需要确保该安全组的入方向规则中包含容器需要暴露的协议和端口。如果您在该地域下没有默认安全组，系统将自动创建一个默认安全组，并将您声明的容器协议和端口添加到该安全组的入方向规则中。
description.en:
The ID of the security group to which the instance belongs. Instances in the same security group can access each other.

If no security group is specified, the system automatically uses the default security group in the region that you selected. Make sure that the inbound rules of the security group contain the protocols and port numbers of the containers that you want to expose. If you do not have a default security group in the region, the system creates a default security group and adds the declared container protocols and port numbers to the inbound rules of the security group.

description.zh: 是否使用共享命名空间。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether to use a shared namespace. Default value: false.

description.zh: 抢占式实例的保护期。单位为小时。默认为1。可设置为0，表示无保护期。
description.en: The protection period of the preemptible instance. Unit: hours. Default value: 1. Set this to 0 for no protection period.

description.zh:
设置抢占式实例的每小时最高价格，最多精确到小数点后3位。

当SpotStrategy取值为SpotWithPriceLimit时，必须设置SpotPriceLimit。
description.en:
The maximum hourly price of the preemptible instance. The value can be accurate to three decimal places.

This parameter is required when SpotStrategy is set to SpotWithPriceLimit.

description.zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

- NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
- SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
- SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例。

默认值：NoSpot。
description.en:
The bidding strategy for the instance. Valid values:

- NoSpot: a pay-as-you-go instance.
- SpotWithPriceLimit: a preemptible instance with a maximum price limit.
- SpotAsPriceGo: a preemptible instance that is billed based on the actual market price.

Default value: NoSpot.

description.zh:
是否周期执行：

- true：周期执行。
- false：非周期行执行。
description.en:
Specifies whether to execute periodically:

- true: execute periodically.
- false: do not execute periodically.

description.zh: 标签列表。最多可以绑定20个。更多信息，请参见[使用标签管理实例](~~146608~~)。
description.en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be bound. For more information, see [Use tags to manage instances](~~146608~~).

description.zh: 标签键。如果传入该值，则不允许为空字符串，且不允许重复。最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. This value cannot be an empty string and cannot be duplicate. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 标签值。如果传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. This value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 程序的缓冲时间，用于处理关闭之前的操作。单位为秒。
description.en: The buffer period for the program to handle operations before shutdown. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
实例所属的交换机ID。支持指定多个交换机ID（单次最多10个），各交换机ID之间可以用半角逗号（,）进行分割，例如`vsw-***,vsw-***`。

如果没有指定交换机，系统将自动使用您选择的地域下的默认VPC下的默认交换机，如果您在该地域下没有默认VPC和默认交换机，系统将自动创建一个默认VPC和一个默认交换机。

> 交换机网段内的IP个数决定了该交换机下最大可以创建的ECI实例数量，请务必提前规划好网段。
description.en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the instance is connected. You can specify up to 10 vSwitch IDs at a time, separated by commas (,), for example, `vsw-***,vsw-***`.

If no vSwitch is specified, the system automatically uses the default vSwitch in the default VPC of the region that you selected. If you do not have a default VPC and a default vSwitch in the region, the system creates a default VPC and a default vSwitch.

> The number of IP addresses in the vSwitch CIDR block determines the maximum number of ECI instances that can be created in the vSwitch. Plan the CIDR block in advance.

description.zh: 数据卷信息。
description.en: The volume information.

description.zh:
ConfigFile类型的数据卷信息。

如果配置多个ConfigFileToPath，对应的多个Content的总长度不能超过60 KB。
description.en:
The ConfigFile volume information.

If multiple ConfigFileToPath entries are configured, the total length of all corresponding Content values cannot exceed 60 KB.

description.zh: ConfigFileVolume默认的权限。
description.en: The default permissions of the ConfigFileVolume.

description.zh: DiskVolume的ID。
description.en: The ID of the DiskVolume.

description.zh: DiskVolume的大小。单位为GiB。
description.en: The size of the DiskVolume. Unit: GiB.

description.zh: DiskVolume的系统类型。
description.en: The file system type of the DiskVolume.

description.zh: EmptyDirVolume的存储媒介，默认为空，使用node文件系统；支持 memory，表示使用内存。
description.en: The storage medium for the EmptyDirVolume. Default value: empty, which uses the node file system. The value memory is supported, indicating the use of memory.

description.zh: EmptyDirVolume的大小。单位为GiB。
description.en: The size of the EmptyDirVolume. Unit: GiB.

description.zh:
使用FlexVolume插件挂载数据卷时的驱动类型。取值范围如下：

- alicloud/disk：挂载云盘。
- alicloud/nas：挂载NAS。
- alicloud/oss：挂载OSS。
description.en:
The driver type when using the FlexVolume plugin to mount volumes. Valid values:

- alicloud/disk: mount a cloud disk.
- alicloud/nas: mount NAS.
- alicloud/oss: mount OSS.

description.zh: 挂载的文件系统类型，默认取决于FlexVolume的script。
description.en: The file system type to mount. Default value depends on the FlexVolume script.

description.zh:
FlexVolume对象选项列表。为KV形式，采用JSON传递。

例如通过FlexVolume挂载云盘时，Options表示云盘的配置参数，可配置的参数如下：

- volumeId：已有云盘ID。
- volumeSize：云盘大小，单位为GiB。取值范围为20~32768。
- performanceLevel：云盘性能等级。更多信息，请参见[云盘性能等级](~~25382~~)。
- deleteWithInstance：是否随实例释放，默认为false。
- encrypted：是否加密云盘，默认为false。更多信息，请参见[加密概述](~~59643~~)。
- kmsKeyId：加密云盘时，云盘使用的KMS密钥ID。
description.en:
The FlexVolume option list. This is in key-value format and passed as JSON.

For example, when mounting a cloud disk via FlexVolume, Options represents the cloud disk configuration parameters. The configurable parameters are as follows:

- volumeId: the ID of an existing cloud disk.
- volumeSize: the size of the cloud disk. Unit: GiB. Valid values: 20 to 32768.
- performanceLevel: the performance level of the cloud disk. For more information, see [Cloud disk performance levels](~~25382~~).
- deleteWithInstance: specifies whether to release the disk with the instance. Default value: false.
- encrypted: specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Default value: false. For more information, see [Encryption overview](~~59643~~).
- kmsKeyId: the KMS key ID used for cloud disk encryption.

description.zh: HostPath Volume在主机上的目录路径。
description.en: The directory path of the HostPath volume on the host.

description.zh:
HostPath Volume的类型。取值范围：

 - Directory：目录。
- File：文件。

> HostPath Volume仅对白名单用户开放使用。
description.en:
The type of the HostPath volume. Valid values:

- Directory: a directory.
- File: a file.

> HostPath volumes are available only to allowlisted users.

description.zh: NFS数据卷路径。
description.en: The NFS volume path.

description.zh: NFS数据卷是否只读。默认为false。
description.en: Specifies whether the NFS volume is read-only. Default value: false.

description.zh: NFS服务器地址。
description.en: The NFS server address.

description.zh: 数据卷名称。
description.en: The volume name.

description.zh:
数据卷类型。取值范围：

- EmptyDirVolume：EmptyDir类型的数据卷，表示空目录。
- NFSVolume：NFS类型的数据卷，表示网络文件系统。
- ConfigFileVolume：ConfigFile类型的数据卷，表示配置文件。
- FlexVolume：使用FlexVolume插件扩展存储类型，支持挂载云盘。
- HostPathVolume：HostPath类型的数据卷，表示主机节点的文件或目录。该类型仅对白名单用户开放使用。
- DiskVolume（不推荐）：云盘数据卷。建议使用FlexVolume挂载云盘。
description.en:
The volume type. Valid values:

- EmptyDirVolume: an EmptyDir volume, which represents an empty directory.
- NFSVolume: an NFS volume, which represents a Network File System.
- ConfigFileVolume: a ConfigFile volume, which represents a configuration file.
- FlexVolume: uses the FlexVolume plugin to extend storage types. Supports mounting cloud disks.
- HostPathVolume: a HostPath volume, which represents a file or directory on the host node. This type is available only to allowlisted users.
- DiskVolume (not recommended): a cloud disk volume. We recommend that you use FlexVolume to mount cloud disks.

description.zh:
实例所属的可用区。如果取值为空，则表示由系统选择。

默认值为空。
description.en:
The zone of the instance. If the value is empty, the system automatically selects a zone.

Default value: empty.

descriptions.zh:
调用CreateContainerGroup创建ECI实例时，系统将自动为您创建一个服务关联角色AliyunServiceRoleForECI，用于访问ECS、VPC等相关云服务。更多信息，请参见[弹性容器实例服务关联角色](~~212914~~)。

创建ECI实例时，您可以根据需要配置实例、镜像、存储等相关功能。各功能涉及的参数及其说明，请参见以下功能文档：

**实例**

ECI支持以下两种方式创建实例：
- [指定vCPU和内存创建实例](~~114662~~)
- [指定ECS规格创建实例](~~114664~~)

以下功能两种创建方式均支持：
- [创建抢占式实例](~~157759~~)
- [配置多可用区](~~157290~~)
- [配置多规格](~~146468~~)
- [使用标签管理实例](~~146608~~)

**镜像**
- [配置容器镜像](~~461311~~)
- [使用镜像缓存加速创建实例](~~141281~~)
- [指定ACR企业版实例](~~194250~~)
- [使用自建镜像仓库](~~378059~~)

**网络**
- [绑定EIP](~~99146~~)
- [指定安全组](~~176237~~)
- [配置IPv6地址](~~451282~~)
- [配置带宽限速](~~190635~~)

**存储**
- [挂载云盘数据卷](~~144571~~)
- [挂载NAS数据卷](~~464075~~)
- [挂载OSS数据卷](~~464076~~)
- [挂载EmptyDir数据卷](~~464078~~)
- [挂载ConfigFile数据卷](~~464080~~)
- [自定义临时存储空间大小](~~204066~~)

**容器配置**
- [设置容器启动命令和参数](~~94593~~)
- [使用探针对容器进行健康检查](~~99053~~)
- [通过环境变量获取元数据](~~141788~~)
- [配置Security Context](~~462313~~)
- [配置NTP服务](~~462768~~)


**日志与运维**

descriptions.en:
When you call CreateContainerGroup to create an ECI instance, the system automatically creates a service-linked role AliyunServiceRoleForECI for you to access related cloud services such as ECS and VPC. For more information, see [ECI service-linked role](~~212914~~).

When creating an ECI instance, you can configure instance, image, storage, and other related features as needed. For the parameters and descriptions of each feature, see the following documentation:

**Instance**

ECI supports the following two methods to create instances:
- [Create an instance by specifying vCPU and memory](~~114662~~)
- [Create an instance by specifying an ECS instance type](~~114664~~)

The following features are supported by both creation methods:
- [Create preemptible instances](~~157759~~)
- [Configure multiple zones](~~157290~~)
- [Configure multiple instance types](~~146468~~)
- [Use tags to manage instances](~~146608~~)

**Image**
- [Configure container images](~~461311~~)
- [Use image caches to accelerate instance creation](~~141281~~)
- [Specify ACR Enterprise Edition instances](~~194250~~)
- [Use self-managed image repositories](~~378059~~)

**Network**
- [Bindl EIPs](~~99146~~)
- [Specify security groups](~~176237~~)
- [Configure IPv6 addresses](~~451282~~)
- [Configure bandwidth throttling](~~190635~~)

**Storage**
- [Mount cloud disk volumes](~~144571~~)
- [Mount NAS volumes](~~464075~~)
- [Mount OSS volumes](~~464076~~)
- [Mount EmptyDir volumes](~~464078~~)
- [Mount ConfigFile volumes](~~464080~~)
- [Customize the size of temporary storage](~~204066~~)

**Container configuration**
- [Set container startup commands and arguments](~~94593~~)
- [Use probes for container health checks](~~99053~~)
- [Obtain metadata through environment variables](~~141788~~)
- [Configure Security Context](~~462313~~)
- [Configure NTP service](~~462768~~)


**Logging and O&M**
- [Configure log collection through environment variables](~~121973~~)
- [Save core files to a data volume](~~167801~~)
